description: This file defines culture-specific settings and date formatting/parsing methods for the Arabic (Saudi Arabia) locale, using the Datejs library. It includes culture info such as month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, and prototype methods for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Sets the time components of the date to zero, effectively clearing the time part.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date's time components to the current local time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a new Date object with the same time value.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date instance with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this date is equal to another date.

methods.name: addMilliseconds
methods.description: Adds a specified number of milliseconds to this date.

methods.name: addSeconds
methods.description: Adds seconds to the date.

methods.name: addMinutes
methods.description: Adds minutes to the date.

methods.name: addHours
methods.description: Adds hours to the date.

methods.name: addDays
methods.description: Adds days to the date.

methods.name: addWeeks
methods.description: Adds weeks to the date.

methods.name: addMonths
methods.description: Adds months to the date.

methods.name: addYears
methods.description: Adds years to the date.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the week number for the date.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves the date to the nth occurrence of a weekday in the month.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific day of the week.

methods.name: moveToMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific month.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Returns the week number of the year for the date.

methods.name: getISOWeek
methods.description: Returns the ISO week number.

methods.name: setTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Sets the timezone offset.

methods.name: setTimezone
methods.description: Sets the timezone.

methods.name: hasDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the timezone has daylight saving time.

methods.name: isDaylightSavingTime
methods.description: Checks if the date is in daylight saving time.

methods.name: getUTCOffset
methods.description: Returns the UTC offset string.
